name: correlated-in-duplicates-and-empty
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-not-in-nulls-and-empty
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a NOT IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-row-in-duplicates
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a,o.b) IN (SELECT i.x,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-row-not-in-false-and-unknown
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-row-in-computed-results
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a+1,o.b) IN (SELECT i.x+1,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k<=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-row-not-in-disjunction
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE (i.k=o.k OR i.y=o.b) AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: correlated-not-in-null-equal-key
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a NOT IN (SELECT i.x FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k IS o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;
